checks.route_coverage: Two representative shortest routes for each of three existing food rounds, not all possible routes.

items.caption: cuptor și pâine coaptă
items.rationale: The appliance and baked-food nouns make the oven-to-bread step immediately legible. This is a common use of an oven, without asserting that every bread must be baked in this particular appliance.

items.caption: pâine și bucățele desprinse
items.rationale: Detached small pieces explain the bread-to-crumb step in ordinary Romanian. The phrase describes the relation without saying every cut necessarily produces crumbs.

items.caption: cuptor și biscuiți copți
items.rationale: The caption identifies an ordinary biscuit preparation method and distinguishes the oven from an ingredient. No reverse traversal or exclusive cooking method is implied.

items.caption: biscuit și bucățele desprinse
items.rationale: The small-fragment meaning of crumb covers a broken biscuit. This is a specific material relation, not merely two foods, and the wording does not require crumbs from every bite.

items.caption: frișcă și îndulcitor opțional
items.rationale: Optional is a necessary qualifier here: unsweetened whipped cream exists. Naming a sweetener explains powdered sugar’s role without making it part of the definition of whipped cream.

items.caption: tort și frișca din cremă
items.rationale: The filling role is more informative than part and whole. The displayed cake identity makes the ordinary Diplomat cream association specific; the phrase is not a claim about every kind of cake.

items.caption: pișcot și zahăr de presărat
items.rationale: Sugar for dusting identifies its purpose rather than claiming it is an obligatory ladyfinger ingredient. The documented dusted version supplies a plausible earned connection.

items.caption: tort și margine cu pișcoturi
items.rationale: A ladyfinger rim is a documented Diplomat construction and gives the player a visible structural reason for the step. The pair phrase names this supported preparation, without defining all Diplomat variants as identical.

items.caption: plăcintă și aromă de vanilie
items.rationale: Vanilla aroma describes a familiar sweet-cheese pastry variation. It avoids suggesting that vanilla alone creates the pastry or that every recipe must use it.

items.caption: plăcintă și umplutură de brânză
items.rationale: The cheese filling is a clear ordinary reason for the pastry link. The noun phrase remains true when the existing bidirectional edge is traversed from cheese to pastry.

items.caption: pască și aromă de vanilie
items.rationale: Vanilla supplies an understandable flavor association in the traditional cheese pască version. Neither universal ingredient necessity nor an entire recipe is stated.

items.caption: pască și umplutură de brânză
items.rationale: Cheese filling identifies the traditional dough-based pască version represented by this edge. The phrase remains intelligible in both existing directions and does not assert that other pască variants do not exist.

limits: Independent semantic, source-scope and complete-edge review. Final earned-only API display, recovery and narrow-screen readability require separate implementation checks.
